name: gap_fill_stall_001
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, overnight gap-downs exceeding 1.2% reflect FII-driven or macro-driven price dislocation. During the first 15 minutes (09:15-09:30), algorithmic market makers and liquidity providers absorb order flow and establish the opening range. When NIFTY subsequently dips below the OR low within a single 5-second bar — triggering resting stop-loss orders and programmatic short entries — but fails to sustain below it (close recovers back above OR low in the same bar), the short-side flow is exhausted and absorbed. VWAP-benchmarked institutional buyers, who are already tracking a benchmark significantly above current price, step in aggressively to exploit the dip, driving a reversal toward session VWAP. At 5-second resolution, we detect this fakeout in real time and enter at the exact bar of stall rather than waiting for the full 1-minute confirmation, capturing the early leg of the reversal.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP is cumulative from day open — no lookback scaling needed. Acts as the gap-fill target; the thesis is that NIFTY reverts toward VWAP after the fakeout, so VWAP must be above price to justify a bullish entry.

indicators.name: or_high
indicators.formula: MAX(high) over bars where time_minutes in [555, 570)
indicators.purpose: Opening range is a FIXED TIME WINDOW (09:15-09:30 = 180 bars at 5s). Same 15 minutes as original — not scaled by bar size. OR high is the fakeout level on gap-up days: a brief spike above triggers stops that then get absorbed.

indicators.name: or_low
indicators.formula: MIN(low) over bars where time_minutes in [555, 570)
indicators.purpose: Same FIXED TIME WINDOW as or_high. OR low is the fakeout level on gap-down days: a brief dip below triggers stop cascades. If NIFTY closes back above OR low in the same 5s bar, the breakdown has failed and reversal begins.

indicators.name: gap_pct
indicators.purpose: Overnight gap size — a session-level condition computed once at open and carried through the day. Threshold of 1.2% matches original and identifies genuine macro/FII dislocation rather than intraday noise. Gaps below this threshold produce weaker OR fakeouts because there is less trapped short interest.

indicators.name: rel_vol_120
indicators.purpose: Relative volume vs 10-min rolling average (120 bars x 5s). Original used 20-min average on 1-min bars. Compressed to 10 min because at 5s resolution, the volume surge accompanying a fakeout bar is a 5-15 second event — a stale 20-min baseline would wash out the signal. Threshold 1.2x ensures the fakeout bar has real participation, not a thin-market artifact.

indicators.name: nifty_ret_60
indicators.purpose: 5-min NIFTY return (60 bars x 5s). Original used 15-min index return to filter one-way trending markets. Compressed to 5 min because we hold 15-90s — if NIFTY is in a strong 5-min directional move (>0.4%), the gap-fade mean-reversion thesis is invalidated. A trailing strong trend suppresses the OR fakeout bounce.

conditions: low < or_low (current bar touched below OR low — fakeout test)
close >= or_low (price closes back above OR low — stall confirmed)
close < vwap (upside gap-fill potential toward VWAP)
close > open (bullish candle close on the fakeout bar)
rel_vol_120 >= rel_vol_threshold (volume surge confirms participation, default 1.2x)
abs(nifty_ret_60) <= trend_threshold (NIFTY not in one-way trend, default 0.4%)
time_minutes in [570, 645) (09:30-10:45 window, OR fully formed)
buy_ce.confirmation: Single-bar signal — fakeout and recovery in same 5s candle

conditions: high > or_high (current bar touched above OR high — fakeout test)
close <= or_high (price closes back below OR high — stall confirmed)
close > vwap (downside gap-fill potential toward VWAP)
close < open (bearish candle close on the fakeout bar)
buy_pe.confirmation: Single-bar signal — fakeout and rejection in same 5s candle

exit.stop_rationale: If NIFTY sustains below OR low, the fakeout thesis is invalid — NIFTY typically moves 8-12 spot pts from OR low before finding structural support. 4 option points (delta ~0.5 = 8 spot pts) represents the threshold where the bounce is no longer a fakeout but a genuine breakdown.
exit.target_rationale: Gap fill from OR low toward session VWAP typically covers 15-25 spot pts on NIFTY in the 09:30-10:45 window; 7 option pts captures ~50-60% of expected move (delta ~0.5, 7 pts = ~14 spot pts), giving 1:1.75 R:R. The 7-pt target is calibrated to 60-90s hold time where 1-2 min NIFTY moves average 3-7 option pts.

filters.vix_filter: none — gap fakeouts occur across all VIX regimes; the OR structure itself provides the volatility context
filters.time_filter: 09:30-10:45 IST only; OR must be fully formed (180 bars = 15 min completed)
filters.volume_filter: rel_vol_120 >= 1.2 ensures the fakeout bar has real market participation
filters.trend_filter: abs(nifty_ret_60) <= 0.004 excludes trending markets where OR fakeout reversals are overridden by sustained directional flow
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close prices

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — OR fakeout patterns are well-known; execution at 5s granularity reduces crowding risk vs 1-min bars, but pattern frequency on NIFTY index is lower than on stocks

adaptation_notes: Original traded top-200 nifty500 stocks for gap fades. Converted to NIFTY index because the gap-stall-at-OR pattern is cleaner on the index (no single-stock idiosyncratic risk, driven purely by macro/FII flow, index volume is deep). Stock-specific rel_volume filter kept but baseline compressed from 20-min to 10-min for responsiveness at 5s. Index conflict filter (original: abs(nifty50_return_15min) < 0.4%) repurposed as self-referential 5-min trend filter on NIFTY (abs(nifty_ret_60) < 0.4%). Hold time compressed from 5-15 min to 15-90s because we enter at the exact fakeout bar rather than confirming on the next 1-min bar. VWAP removed from exits — the time_stop_bars=18 (90s) handles the hold time instead of VWAP crossing.
weaknesses: Gap frequency on NIFTY index is lower than individual stocks (1-2 qualifying gap-down/up days per week vs multiple stocks daily) — low trade frequency
OR fakeout detection is single-bar dependent at 5s: data gaps or latency spikes could cause false signals or missed entries
If a second macro event hits during the 09:30-10:45 window, gap can widen rather than fill, converting a fakeout entry into a losing gap-extension trade

_source.original_stop: 0.50% from entry or failed OR break level
